name: smx-v8-bath
comment: Dense-ambient wind tunnel: emitter plane x=24 (r=1, 4-grid y/z, dir +x, q=4) sustains a moving medium into the x-sponge. Tests whether the desert regime distorted the laws: bath_only calibrates ambient density; bath_knot = survival in bath; bath_arc50 = does ambient inflow arrest the upstream starvation fray; bath_gap10 = does the medium bridge a 10-cell gap; vacuum controls replicate known baselines.
